title: Cardinal DriveSense Teen Coach — Scored Driver, Parent Alerts and Ageing Out
content:
**The rule.** The Cardinal DriveSense Teen Coach program scores one rated driver no older than the program's oldest accepted driver age on the enrollment date, using the driver's profile in the app. The named insured receives speeding and late-night alerts where the program includes parent alerts. The teen's adjustment is rescored every term where the program rescores each term, and it is not kept after opting out. When the scored driver passes the oldest accepted age the enrollment continues to the end of the current term and is then ended; the vehicle may enroll in another program after the re-enrollment waiting period.

The oldest accepted driver age is 19 on Cardinal DriveSense Teen Coach; the other five programs have no driver age requirement (0, not applicable).

## The rule in parts

| Subject | Teen Coach treatment |
|---|---|
| Who is scored | One rated driver, through that driver's profile in the app |
| Age test | The driver's age on the enrollment date is no older than 19 |
| Alerts | Speeding and late-night alerts go to the named insured, where the program includes parent alerts |
| Each term | The teen's adjustment is rescored every term, where the program rescores each term |
| Opt-out | The teen's adjustment is not kept |
| Driver passes the age | The enrollment continues to the end of the current term and is then ended |
| After it ends | The vehicle may enroll in another program after the re-enrollment waiting period |

## Training questions

**The rated driver is 19 on the enrollment date. Can that driver be the scored driver?**
Yes. 19 is no older than the oldest accepted age of 19.

**The rated driver turned 20 the month before the enrollment date. Can that driver be the scored driver?**
No. On the enrollment date the driver is older than 19.

**The scored driver turns 20 in the fourth month of the term. What happens to the enrollment?**
It continues to the end of the current term and is then ended. The vehicle may enroll in another program after the re-enrollment waiting period.

**The customer opts the teen out mid-term. Does the teen's adjustment carry on?**
No. The teen's adjustment is not kept after opting out.

**Who receives the alerts?**
The named insured, for speeding and late-night driving, where the program includes parent alerts.
